SymbolicEssence.ArchetypalFunction: Chthonic deity embodying vegetation cycles, serpent wisdom, underworld guardianship, and the tree of life
SymbolicEssence.SymbolicCore: The serpent-tree god - roots in underworld, branches in heaven, cyclic renewal

Correspondences.Color: Serpent Green, Root Brown, Life Gold

DevelopmentalArc: Tree God → Underworld Service → Guardian Role → Seasonal Cycle → Serpent Wisdom → Throne Bearer

CulturalContext.ReligiousOrRitualUse: Vegetation festivals, underworld journeys, serpent wisdom rites, guardian invocations, agricultural cycles, medical/healing serpent work
CulturalContext.HistoricalEvolution: Ancient Sumerian chthonic deity, remained important as underworld and vegetation god, merged with serpent wisdom traditions, influenced caduceus symbolism

SymbolicRepresentation.ImageryNotes: Depicted with entwined serpents (like caduceus), as dragon/serpent, with sacred tree, underworld guardian, vegetation imagery, serpent wisdom staff
SymbolicRepresentation.PoeticInvocation: I am the serpent coiled around the tree of life, roots in death, branches in heaven, wisdom that renews through cycles.
SymbolicRepresentation.DreamForm: A tree with serpent roots; entwined snakes guarding the threshold; vegetation rising from underworld; cyclic death and renewal

MetaIntegration.RitualFunction: Invoke for serpent wisdom, underworld work, vegetation cycles, guardian energy, renewal through death, tree of life meditation
AIPromptSeeds: Generate a serpent-tree deity whose roots touch death and branches reach heaven, embodying cyclic renewal.
Create a guardian of thresholds between worlds, serpent-wise and vegetation-renewed.
NarrativeHooks: The serpent around the tree of life
